outcomes.name: Visibility & Prioritization
outcomes.impact: I can see, prioritize, and manage all work from my phone without starting a session. This is the foundation — nothing else is manageable without it.

outcomes.name: Application Lands
outcomes.impact: Applications submitted to Anthropic + 3-5 labs with CCA-F cert, portfolio with thesis, and content in my voice. Gets interviews.

outcomes.name: Deadweight Has Signal
outcomes.impact: Real carrier data validates the tool, real prospects react. Becomes portfolio evidence AND potential revenue.

outcomes.name: Build Velocity
outcomes.impact: Ship more with less intervention per session. Agents handle their own failures, evaluate their own output.

outcomes.name: Composter Validated
outcomes.impact: Market signal from real Brooklyn PMs — genuine interest or honest rejection.

deliverables.title: Register LLC + professional email
deliverables.impact: Gating dependency — blocks Partner Network, which blocks exam registration. Nothing moves without this.

deliverables.title: Complete 6 targeted Anthropic Academy courses
deliverables.impact: Fills the safety/reliability knowledge gap (15% of exam, biggest weakness). Building experience is strong — this is the theory gap.

deliverables.title: Take CCA-F exam
deliverables.impact: The credential itself. Compresses Anthropic timeline from 9-12 months to 6-8 weeks. Cert + portfolio = credibility shortcut.

deliverables.title: Apply to Anthropic + 3-5 labs
deliverables.impact: THE outcome. Everything else is preparation for this moment.

deliverables.title: Blog posts to 100% (AI Pricing first, then Infra Beats Convenience)
deliverables.impact: Blog posts are the writing samples reviewers will read. AI Pricing has the strongest idea but weakest execution. Each post must land like Deadweight does: clear thesis, real numbers, point of view.

deliverables.title: Portfolio 'so what' — thesis for Obsidian MCP, Agentic Stack, Portfolio Analysis
deliverables.impact: These projects are inward-facing tools. Without a thesis, a reviewer sees 'built stuff for self.' With one, they see what it proves about how Daniel thinks.

deliverables.title: About page narrative flow — make transitions read as story
deliverables.impact: Voice is strong but transitions are abrupt. The thread connecting architecture → GPT skepticism → Claude → constraint → toddler exists but is implicit. Reviewers need the story, not the sequence.

deliverables.title: Portfolio narrative — connect MCP + taxonomy + agentic stack as AI product story
deliverables.impact: Turns separate projects into a coherent argument: 'I build production AI systems and I think about them as products, not just code.'

deliverables.title: Voice audit — score 4 posts + agentic stack for Daniel vs Claude voice
deliverables.impact: AI-generated portfolio applying to AI company is a credibility killer. This identifies exactly which content needs rewriting vs. minor pass.

deliverables.title: Build voice reference corpus (3-5 Daniel samples)
deliverables.impact: Grounds all future content generation in Daniel's actual voice — direct, specific, opinionated. Without this, every draft starts from Claude's polished-neutral default.

deliverables.title: Update /draft skill with compose mode
deliverables.impact: Daniel provides raw voice input, Claude structures without rewriting. Different from current multi-pass revision that smooths out the edges.

deliverables.title: Rewrite weakest posts (AI Pricing first)
deliverables.impact: Fixes the content that's actively hurting the portfolio. AI Pricing has the strongest idea but reads like Claude wrote it.

deliverables.title: Test Deadweight on real carrier invoice, document failure modes
deliverables.impact: The credibility threshold. Demo on real data is the difference between prototype and product. Also surfaces edge cases synthetics can't simulate.

deliverables.title: Tune benchmarks with Daniel's carrier expertise
deliverables.impact: Daniel's carrier-side expertise overrides research-based defaults. Makes output trustworthy for real prospects.

deliverables.title: Add carrier intelligence rules
deliverables.impact: Daniel knows specific carrier tactics beyond what research captured. This is the domain knowledge moat.

deliverables.title: Cold-email 5 freight contacts
deliverables.impact: First real market signal. Honest rejection or genuine interest — not validation theater from warm intros.

deliverables.title: Build formal eval suite (automated accuracy measurement)
deliverables.impact: Makes accuracy measurable, regression-testable, and demonstrable. Enables confident iteration on extraction prompts without breaking existing cases.

deliverables.title: Wire intervention mechanism — blocker handoffs to known location
deliverables.impact: Agents currently stall silently on blockers. This makes failures visible so Daniel can unblock without hunting through session logs.

deliverables.title: Unified page-level evaluation rubric (content + design together)
deliverables.impact: Current separate evals don't catch when content and design both pass independently but the page is flat. Prevents rework discovered in D2 sprint.

deliverables.title: EVAL.md for remaining producing skills
deliverables.impact: Consistency across all producing skills. Each skill self-evaluates against domain-specific rubric before declaring done.

deliverables.title: Design Notion backlog page structure
deliverables.impact: Maps the deliverable data model to a Notion layout Daniel can scan from his phone. One place to look and know what's planned, running, done, stuck.

deliverables.title: Build vault-to-Notion push
deliverables.impact: The actual sync mechanism. Vault stays source of truth, Notion becomes the live view without manual copy-paste.

deliverables.title: Notion-to-vault pull
deliverables.impact: Closes the loop — Daniel annotates/reprioritizes in Notion from his phone, changes flow back to vault for agents to act on.

deliverables.title: Auto-push on backlog config change (PostToolUse hook)
deliverables.impact: Removes manual sync step. Any session that edits backlog_epics.json triggers a Notion push — not scoped to specific skills.

deliverables.title: /program integration with vault task notes
deliverables.impact: Execution tracking lives in the vault, not just in session context. Tasks persist across sessions with status and handoff notes.

deliverables.title: First outreach — 2-3 Brooklyn PM companies
deliverables.impact: First real conversation with a potential customer. Everything before this is research — this is the market signal.

deliverables.title: OEM supplier research
deliverables.impact: Identifies 3-5 electric composter manufacturers for distribution. Only worth doing after outreach confirms demand signal.
